# ihme

> A command-line tool for iCloud Hide My Email: list, create, edit, deactivate, and export alias addresses. Built for humans who pick addresses by hand, agents that script them, and an embedded BYOK assistant that runs the whole workflow with a taste rubric and a memory.

`ihme` speaks JSON on every command (`--json`, `--jq`), returns actionable errors with the fix command, and uses exit codes agents can branch on (0 ok, 1 error, 2 auth required). It authenticates to Apple over SRP-6a; the password is never transmitted or stored.

## Start here

- [README](README.md): install, quick start, every command, JSON/jq usage, auth details
- [SKILL.md](skill/SKILL.md): the operational procedure both external agents (shell) and the embedded agent follow — including the address taste rubric
- [ROADMAP](ROADMAP.md): what shipped per version and what's planned

## Using it as an agent

- Every command supports `--json` and `--jq`; `--help` documents the response shape
- Errors go to stderr, data to stdout; `--yes` skips confirmation prompts
- `<ref>` resolves by anonymousId, email, or label (fuzzy)
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): command reference for agents that read agents.md

## The embedded agent (`ihme --agent`)

- Bring your own key (any OpenAI-compatible endpoint); config in `~/.config/ihme/agent.json` + `~/.config/ihme/.env`
- Consent gates every mutation; the consent card carries the taste verdict and rejected candidates; typed replies redirect it
- Keeps a Logseq-style markdown memory across runs — inspect with `ihme memory`
- [pkg/agentkit](pkg/agentkit/README.md): the stdlib-only, embeddable agent kernel it runs on — reusable outside this CLI

Unofficial. Uses Apple's undocumented iCloud web API; not affiliated with Apple.
